name: loomcli
description: The Loom CLI application framework. Designed to make developing beautiful command-line tools for humans and agents intuitive.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:examples && vp check && pnpm run check:types && node scripts/generate-unicode-tables.mjs --check && pnpm run loom changelog check
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:examples && vp test --run
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/plugins/tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle-mcp.mjs && tsc -p packages/validators/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/explain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/doctor/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/loom/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/textstat/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/jsonkit/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tests/type-consumer/library/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tests/runtime-consumer/library/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:examples: cd examples/textstat && node ../../packages/loom/dist/main.js build --target node && cd ../jsonkit && node ../../packages/loom/dist/main.js build --target node
